'''Carreras Minor's moon''' was the moon of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carreras Minor]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. There was a [[Ania Solo's junkyard|junkyard]] run by [[Ania Solo]] located on the moon.<ref name="Legacy 2" />
